```python
import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io

pdf_path = "IPCC_AR6_SYR_LongerReport.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

pages_with_mentions = []
contexts = []

for i in range(doc.page_count):
    page = doc[i]
    pix = page.get_pixmap(dpi=200)
    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(pix.tobytes("png")))
    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
    low = text.lower()
    if "nuclear" in low:
        pages_with_mentions.append(i+1)
        # crude context window
        idx = low.find("nuclear")
        start = max(0, idx-80)
        end = min(len(text), idx+80)
        contexts.append((i+1, text[start:end].replace('\n',' ').strip()))

print("OCR-detected pages:", pages_with_mentions)
for p,c in contexts:
    print(f"Page {p} context: {c}")
```
